SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Foreign Section Station,
No. I. O. D. 646.
Date November 12, 1929

Subject (in full) Arrival of Suspected Communist.

Made by P.C.P.S. Medvedeff. Forwarded by Tho Rubentein A.D.I.

Mr. Tasaret Gavisoff, an American citizen of Russian
origin, arrived in Shanghai from Seattle in the s.s.
"Empress of France" on November 1, 1929 and resides at
the Crystal Hotel, 39-41 Seward Road. Gavisoff is reported
to have lived in America for 19 years and is en route to
the Caucasus to visit his brother.

Apparantly on the arrival of the s.s. "Empress of
France" at Yokohama and Kobe, Gavisoff was refused
permission to land owing to the Japanese Authorities
finding a book on Communism among his luggage.

N. Medvedeff
P.C.P.S.
